articles.title: S&P Global Increases Dividend 1.0% to $0.97
articles.summary: PR Newswire: S&P Global Increases Dividend 1.0% to $0.97. The Board of Directors of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI) today approved a 1.0% increase in the regular quarterly cash dividend on the Company's common stock. The 1.0% increase takes into consideration the expected spin of S&P Global's Mobility division into an independent, public company in 2026. Related tickers mentioned: ^GSPC.
